# TapWheel

> The file wheel for Windows: free, open-source file tools on a drag. Drag a file, tap Shift, Ctrl or Alt, and drop it on the wheel that opens under the pointer. Convert, crop, trim, compress, add or remove backgrounds, annotate, redact, tag, format code, pack and unpack archives, rename in bulk and see what a file really is, for pictures, video, sound, icons, text, code and archives. Runs offline with a bundled FFmpeg and background removal model. Made by Jax (muxover). Inspired by Tangerine for Mac.

- [Home](https://tapwheel.app/): what it does, a wheel to play with, every kind of file with its tools and formats, screens of the tool windows, privacy, FAQ, download
- [Privacy](https://tapwheel.app/privacy): the app connects to nothing; the site sets no cookies
- [Support](https://tapwheel.app/support): troubleshooting and contact
- [Source](https://github.com/muxover/tapwheel): GPL-3.0 code, releases and changelog
- [Wheel contents](https://tapwheel.app/data/wheel.json): every format each kind of file opens and every tool the wheels offer, as JSON
